name: Lilyheart Dragon - Young
description: Young Lilyheart is a good-leaning covenant intelligent true dragon with pearl scales and wings shaped like layered lily petals. It seeks to protect the vulnerable and offer mercy before force. At this age it is an emerging but formidable predator.

attacks.name: Petal Claws
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (2)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 2 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Gentle Choice
abilities.description: The dragon can exclude any creatures it chooses from its Silver Mist.

abilities.name: Silver Mist
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 15. On a failure, take 2d8+4 magic damage and if the target is undead or sustained by corrupted aether, it must also mark a Stress. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
